passages.text: Then the LORD said to me, “Go show love to your wife again, though she is loved by another and is an adulteress. Love her as the LORD loves the Israelites, though they turn to other gods and offer raisin cakes to idols.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to me.
He gave me a command.
He said, “Go again.
Love a woman.
She is your wife.
She is loved by another man.
She is an adulteress.
Love her.
Love her as the LORD loves the Israelites.
The Israelites turn away from the LORD.
They worship other gods.
They love raisin cakes offered to idols.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֵלַ֗י ע֚וֹד לֵ֣ךְ אֱ‍ֽהַב־ אִשָּׁ֔ה אֲהֻ֥בַת רֵ֖עַ וּמְנָאָ֑פֶת כְּאַהֲבַ֤ת יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְהֵ֗ם פֹּנִים֙ אֶל־ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים וְאֹהֲבֵ֖י אֲשִׁישֵׁ֥י עֲנָבִֽים׃

passages.text: So I bought her for fifteen shekels of silver and a homer and a lethech of barley.
passages.sermon:
The prophet Hosea obeyed the LORD.
Hosea bought his wife back.
He paid fifteen shekels of silver.
He also gave a homer of barley.
He added a lethech of barley.
passages.original: וָאֶכְּרֶ֣הָ לִּ֔י בַּחֲמִשָּׁ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר כָּ֑סֶף וְחֹ֥מֶר שְׂעֹרִ֖ים וְלֵ֥תֶךְ שְׂעֹרִֽים׃

passages.text: Then I said to her, “You must live with me for many days; you must not be promiscuous or belong to another, and I will do the same for you.”
passages.sermon:
I spoke to my wife.
I said, "You must stay with me for many days."
"You must not be unfaithful."
"You must not belong to another man."
I will also stay with you and be faithful to you."
passages.original: וָאֹמַ֣ר אֵלֶ֗יהָ יָמִ֤ים רַבִּים֙ תֵּ֣שְׁבִי לִ֔י לֹ֣א תִזְנִ֔י וְלֹ֥א תִֽהְיִ֖י לְאִ֑ישׁ וְגַם־ אֲנִ֖י אֵלָֽיִךְ׃

passages.text: For the Israelites must live many days without king or prince, without sacrifice or sacred pillar, and without ephod or idol.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites are God's chosen people.
They will live for many days.
They will not have a king.
They will not have a prince.
They will not offer sacrifices.
They will not have a sacred pillar.
They will not have an ephod.
They will not have idols.
passages.original: כִּ֣י׀ יָמִ֣ים רַבִּ֗ים יֵֽשְׁבוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֵ֥ין מֶ֙לֶךְ֙ וְאֵ֣ין שָׂ֔ר וְאֵ֥ין זֶ֖בַח וְאֵ֣ין מַצֵּבָ֑ה וְאֵ֥ין אֵפ֖וֹד וּתְרָפִֽים׃

passages.text: Afterward, the people of Israel will return and seek the LORD their God and David their king. They will come trembling to the LORD and to His goodness in the last days.
passages.sermon:
The people of Israel will return.
They will look for the LORD.
The LORD is their God.
They will look for David.
David is their king.
They will come to the LORD with fear.
They will come to the LORD’s goodness.
This will happen in the last days.
passages.original: אַחַ֗ר יָשֻׁ֙בוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וּבִקְשׁוּ֙ אֶת־ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֔ם וְאֵ֖ת דָּוִ֣ד מַלְכָּ֑ם וּפָחֲד֧וּ אֶל־ יְהוָ֛ה וְאֶל־ טוּב֖וֹ בְּאַחֲרִ֥ית הַיָּמִֽים׃פ
